modules.title: Introduction to Orukọ (Nouns)
modules.html:
Types of Yoruba nouns, gender and number. This section covers introduction to orukọ (nouns).

Key points

  • Study the meaning, main features and examples of orukọ (nouns).
  • Be able to explain orukọ (nouns) in your own words and give examples.
  • Practise the 50-question quiz for this topic until you score well without notes.

Worked examples

Q: Kí ni iṣẹ́ 'ẹ̀mí' nínú ìpín mẹ́ta tí Yorùbá pín ènìyàn sí?
A: Láti sọ ara di alààyè — In Yoruba metaphysics, the 'Ẹ̀mí' (soul/breath) is the life-giving force provided by Olodumare that animates the 'Ara' (body).

Q: Àpólà-ọ̀rọ̀ wo ni 'Èmi tìkarami'?
A: Àpólà-orúkọ — 'Èmi tìkarami' (I, myself) functions as a noun phrase (Àpólà-orúkọ) focusing on the subject.

examples.q: Kí ni iṣẹ́ 'ẹ̀mí' nínú ìpín mẹ́ta tí Yorùbá pín ènìyàn sí?

quiz.q: Kí ni iṣẹ́ 'ẹ̀mí' nínú ìpín mẹ́ta tí Yorùbá pín ènìyàn sí?
options: Láti fún ènìyàn ní ìjìnlẹ̀ òye
Láti yan orí ní àjálá mọpin
quiz.solution: In Yoruba metaphysics, the 'Ẹ̀mí' (soul/breath) is the life-giving force provided by Olodumare that animates the 'Ara' (body).

quiz.q: Àpólà-ọ̀rọ̀ wo ni 'Èmi tìkarami'?
quiz.solution: 'Èmi tìkarami' (I, myself) functions as a noun phrase (Àpólà-orúkọ) focusing on the subject.

quiz.q: Èwo nínú àwọn wọ̀nyí ni ó jẹ́ àmì-ìdánimọ̀ fún 'Ẹ̀mí' nínú èdè Yorùbá?
quiz.solution: Breathing (Mímí) is the physical manifestation of the presence of 'Ẹ̀mí' (the soul/life force).

quiz.q: Kí ni ìtumọ̀ 'Ààyè'?
quiz.solution: 'Ààyè' refers to being alive or a living space where life exists.

quiz.q: Kí ni 'Èmi' nínú gírámà Yorùbá fún ẹni tí ń sọ̀rọ̀?
quiz.solution: 'Èmi' corresponds to the First Person singular.

quiz.q: Kí ni 'Ìrè'?
quiz.solution: 'Ìrè' refers to goodness or blessings.

quiz.q: Kí ni ìtumọ̀ 'Àkókò'?
quiz.solution: 'Àkókò' means Time.

quiz.q: Ọmọlúàbí ni ẹni tí ó ní:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2024). Correct answer: Ìwà rere.

quiz.q: Ògún jẹ́ òrìṣà:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2024). Correct answer: Irin.

quiz.q: Kí ni 'Synonym'?
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2024). Correct answer: Ọ̀rọ̀ tí ìtumọ̀ jọra.

quiz.q: Kí ni 'Antonym'?
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2024). Correct answer: Ọ̀rọ̀ Òdì.

quiz.q: Fáwẹ̀lì àìránmú:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2024). Correct answer: a, e, ẹ, i....

quiz.q: Èwo ni fáwẹ́lì àránmúpè nínú èdè Yorùbá?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: an, ẹn, in, ọn, un.

quiz.q: Kí ni ìtumọ̀ àkànlò-èdè yìí: 'Ó nà á ní pàṣán abara'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Láti sọ òtítọ́ fun un.

quiz.q: Kí ni ìtumọ̀ àmì 'Re'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Low Tone.

quiz.q: Èwo ni ounjẹ tí a fi 'Ẹ̀wà' ṣe?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Àkàrà.

quiz.q: Kí ni ìtumọ̀ 'Ìlú' nínú aṣa Yorùbá?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Town/City.

quiz.q: Orúkọ 'Adewale' jẹ́ orúkọ _____.
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Orúkọ Àbísọ.

quiz.q: Èwo nínú wọ̀nyí ni àpólà ọ̀rọ̀ ìṣe?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: ń jẹun.

quiz.q: Lítíréṣọ̀ Yorùbá pín sí ọ̀nà mélòó?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Méjì.

quiz.q: Kí ni 'Bàtà'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Drum.

quiz.q: Orúkọ mìíràn fún 'Èṣù' ni:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Ẹlẹ́gbára.

quiz.q: Ọbẹ̀ tí a ń fi jẹ Iyán ni:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Ẹ̀gúsí.

quiz.q: Kí ni à ń pe 'Antonym' ní Yorùbá?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Ọ̀rọ̀-Òdì / Ìdàkejì.

quiz.q: Kí ni ìtúmọ̀ 'Ẹ kú àárọ̀'?
